status: historical replay and explicitly post-hoc reanalysis; no new model or human data

missingNoveltySensitivity.status: hypothetical exhaustive sensitivity; no source scores changed

study2.policy: Remove the repeated g3/out-35 record once; retain g3/out-48 as missing; this is sensitivity, not repair of original data.

corrections.statement: 240 rows conceal one duplicate and one missing Study 2 judgment.
Floating-point representations split mathematically tied ranks. Rational-equivalent tie handling changes genuineness p from .3125 to .296875; novelty p is unchanged.
The original rule uses a point-estimate threshold and CI exclusion of zero. It does not require the lower bound to exceed .30.

arms.W: shipped wildcard skill (plugin/SKILL.md), draw pinned to a derived seed
arms.P: plain brainstorm, study-1 arm-C prompt verbatim

provenance.judgingIndependence: Four labeled grader runs of the same requested model; independent human experts or cross-vendor replication not established.
provenance.registration: Commit e387745 precedes collection-artifact commit 406af96. Independent timing of actual model execution is not established by Git chronology alone.

claims.statement: The recorded Wildcard treatment averaged 0.725 points higher in judged novelty than the specified plain prompt.
claims.caveat: Available-case historical result; same-vendor model judges; limited to the recorded treatment and task pool.

claims.statement: Study 3 met its original rule: a novelty point estimate of at least +0.30 and a 95% interval excluding zero.
claims.caveat: The interval does not establish a minimum +0.30 effect with 95% confidence; historical completeness is not met.
Two judgments are absent: g4/P-p48-r3 and g3/P-p47-r2; no scores were recovered or invented.

claims.statement: Six plain-arm fabrication flags concerned two outputs; Wildcard had zero flagged outputs.
claims.caveat: Flags are model judgments, not independently adjudicated factual errors. Zero flags do not prove zero errors.

claims.statement: Judged usefulness was 0.233 points lower with Wildcard.
claims.caveat: Exploratory; percentile bootstrap CI is negative while the different signed-rank test gives p=0.140625. Non-significance does not establish equality.

claims.statement: Study 2 has 240 stored grading rows but 239 unique grader-output pairs.
claims.caveat: New audit finding: g3/out-35 is duplicated identically and g3/out-48 is missing. The intended identity of the repeated row is unknown.

claims.statement: All 30 recorded Study 3 treatment draws couple the mode to lens-index parity.
claims.caveat: The historical effect belongs to this legacy sampler. The direction of bias relative to an independent sampler is unknown.
